title: Decorative + Invisible Sulfur Cubes
description: Name a Sulfur Cube "invisible" to turn it permanently invisible!
body:
# Decorative Sulfur Cubes!!
### Name a Sulfur Cube "invisible" using a name tag to turn it permanently invisible! Fully survival friendly!

![A variety of coloured blocks inside invisible sulfur cubes using this datapack](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/1ec71d5bcf1e5e29f8d03bf4748eba4a1af55fad.png)

### Great for:
 - Decorative blocks
 - Minigames
 - Buildstone

# Features:
- Use a name tag to hide the sulfur cube but keep the block inside visible
- The name above the sulfur cube will automatically hide if it has a block in it
- If the block is removed from the sulfur cube, the invisibility will wear off and the name will reappear
- A named sulfur cube will not turn invisible if they do not contain a block
- Only works on sulfur cubes so that the datapack remains balanced for survival purposes. 

# Demo:

_Applying the name tag_

![A sulfur cube turning invisible after being named "invisible" with a name tag](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/29a17b0020728921a76dbf1a33cc72288f9fceff.gif)

_Giving a block to a pre-named sulfur cube_

![A named sulfur cube turning invisible after a block is fed to it/added](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/961bd4bae0e0b2215a04e05301fc29f8f650659d.gif)

_Removing a block from an invisible sulfur cube_

![A sulfur cube becoming visible again after its block is removed from it](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/53f5086f930b29a86563f2969de33fd8be18369f.gif)

Note: I made this datapack very quickly so there may be a few bugs I don't know about, I will try to fix any issues as they come.
